## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Content-first starter interface

The starter SHALL allow routine authors to publish documentation by editing `docs/**/*.md`, `docs/**/*.mdx`, and `static/**` without editing theme source.

#### Scenario: Author adds a document

- **WHEN** an author adds a valid Markdown file beneath `docs/`
- **THEN** the development and production builds SHALL include the document in navigation and routing

### Requirement: Autogenerated sidebar

The starter SHALL derive its default sidebar from the docs filesystem and SHALL allow title and order changes through front matter.

#### Scenario: Author orders a document

- **WHEN** an author sets `title` and `sidebar_position` in document front matter
- **THEN** the generated sidebar SHALL display that label and order without a manual sidebar entry

### Requirement: Markdown, GFM, and MDX fixtures

The starter SHALL document and render headings, automatic anchors/TOC, emphasis, blockquotes, lists, links, local/static images, GFM tables/task lists/strikethrough, fenced and inline code, admonitions, details, tabs, front matter, and a custom MDX component.

#### Scenario: Markdown fixture production build

- **WHEN** CI builds the representative authoring fixture
- **THEN** every declared Markdown/GFM/MDX feature SHALL render without compilation errors, broken links, or broken anchors

### Requirement: Mermaid diagram support

The starter SHALL enable official Docusaurus Mermaid support and provide flowchart, sequence, and state diagram fixtures.

#### Scenario: Diagram rendering by color mode

- **WHEN** the Mermaid fixture loads in light and dark modes
- **THEN** each declared diagram SHALL be visible, legible, and free of page overflow

### Requirement: Explicit customization seams

The starter SHALL expose semantic token values in `src/css/tokens.css` and site metadata/navigation in `docusaurus.config.ts` as the supported customization seams.

#### Scenario: Branding customization

- **WHEN** a user changes documented token values and site metadata
- **THEN** the theme SHALL update branding without requiring edits in `node_modules` or package source

### Requirement: No upstream content leakage

The starter SHALL NOT include upstream OpenAPI demo pages, API navigation, Palo Alto social/community links, or upstream Algolia credentials.

#### Scenario: Starter content audit

- **WHEN** CI scans starter source and built output
- **THEN** upstream demo routes, credentials, and unrelated branding SHALL be absent while required attribution remains present
